name: Card
intent: Groups related content and actions about one subject on a raised surface: a summary, a settings section, an item in a grid. Has an optional title, body content and right-aligned actions. Combine several Cards in a grid, or put a form of TextFields inside one.

props.name: subtitle
props.description: One line of supporting text under the title.

props.name: headingLevel
props.description: HTML heading level of the title, to keep the page outline correct.

props.name: actions
props.description: Buttons at the bottom, right-aligned. Primary action last.

props.name: variant
props.description: elevated on page backgrounds, outlined inside other surfaces or in dense grids.

props.name: padding
props.description: Inner spacing from the space tokens.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Accessible name when there is no title.

variants.name: elevated
variants.intent: Default. Separates the card from the page with a shadow.

variants.name: outlined
variants.intent: Inside another surface or in dense grids where shadows add noise.

when: Showing a self-contained summary of one thing (a project, a plan, an order).
Splitting a long settings page into titled sections.
Laying out several comparable items in a grid.

whenNot.situation: Wrapping the whole page or a single line of text
Content that needs the user's full attention

composition: Do not nest elevated Cards; use variant="outlined" for an inner card.
Keep actions to one primary Button plus at most two secondary ones.
Cards in a grid use the same padding and variant.

accessibility.role: none (a generic container); the title is a real heading
keyboard: Not focusable itself; its buttons and inputs are
notes: Set headingLevel so headings stay in order on the page.
Do not make the whole card clickable and also put buttons inside it.

examples.title: Summary with actions
examples.code:
<Card title="Pro plan" subtitle="Billed yearly" actions={<Button>Upgrade</Button>}>
  <Typography>Unlimited projects and priority support.</Typography>
</Card>
